peer mentoring of undergraduate research (PMUR) workshops can provide students in community colleges (CCs), who are underrepresented in the sciences, with the knowledge and skills they need to succeed in undergraduate research experiences (UREs) and that PMUR workshops are a viable and sustainable model for CCs to implement.

the peer mentoring workshop model is effective for CCs, that it is transplantable to other institutions, and that it is a cost-effective way to provide undergraduate students with the skills and knowledge needed to engage in research and to be successful in graduate school.
